description: Per-component coverage exemptions for the HELiX library. Components listed here are exempt from the 80% CI coverage gate. Each exemption must include a remediation target date. New or modified components are NOT eligible for exemption.

hx-color-picker.reason: Complex canvas/pointer event interactions are difficult to cover in browser tests without manual gesture simulation. Remediation tracked in GitHub issue.

hx-date-picker.reason: Calendar grid keyboard navigation and locale-specific edge cases require extended test coverage work.

hx-time-picker.reason: Time parsing edge cases and AM/PM toggle interactions need additional test coverage.

hx-data-table.reason: Sorting, pagination, and column resize interactions require significant test expansion.

hx-tree-view.reason: Recursive tree rendering and keyboard traversal across deeply nested nodes needs broader coverage.

hx-file-upload.reason: Drag-and-drop and file validation paths require browser File API test infrastructure not yet in place.

hx-carousel.reason: Touch/swipe gesture handling and autoplay interval logic need additional test coverage.

hx-split-panel.reason: Drag-to-resize pointer event coverage requires additional gesture simulation.
